== Strategy ==

Well, first off this is a pretty neat little deck that I saw and I thought that I had to put this one up, simply due to its originality. This is Version 1.0 of this deck...If you think you can improve on it send me a mail. Basically you want to get Serper out as an Undercover spy, slap a ASP droid down at the same site. Use their Game text to place your portable Scanners on top of your Reserve deck. now destiny 8 with Serper's text. Use the Sabotage's to rid yourself of those pesky AT-ATs. Covert Landing will help you draw additional destiny, along with the Electrobinoculars and ASP droids set up the 8s for a few Surprise Assualts. Maneuvering Flaps give you that addition power and forfeit bonus that comes in handy.
